title: Lumbar disc (posterior elements removed) stiffness in 6 DOF at 0.001-1 Hz under 0.4 MPa preload

quantity.name: dynamic stiffness per DOF vs frequency
quantity.definition: slope of force (moment) vs translation (rotation) over cycles 2..end at each frequency. Hexapod axes: +x anterior, +y left lateral, +z superior; rotations about the disc centre (from radiographs); upper vertebra driven, lower fixed. Posterior elements (transverse/spinous processes and facet joints) removed; ALL and PLL preserved.

source.authors: Costi JJ, Stokes IA, Gardner-Morse MG, Iatridis JC
source.n: 9 lumbar vertebra-disc-vertebra segments (L1-L2 x3, L2-L3 x3, L3-L4 x3) from 7 spines; analysed n 6-9 per DOF
source.sample: human cadaveric lumbar discs (donor weight 84.5 (20.8) kg), Thompson grade 1 (2), 3 (5), 4 (1), 5 (1)

protocol.summary: Hexapod robot in 37 C PBS with protease inhibitors; 0.4 MPa axial preload for ~16 h overnight, maintained during all tests; sinusoids at 0.001/0.01/0.1/1 Hz (2/5/10/10 cycles) in random DOF/frequency order with recovery at 0.4 MPa between tests (~44 h per disc).
how_to_simulate: Model a vertebra-disc-vertebra segment without posterior elements (keep ALL/PLL); fix the lower vertebra; rotation centre = disc centre
Equilibrate under 0.4 MPa axial compressive stress (x disc area; paper assumed ~1500 mm2 -> ~600 N) at 37 C if the model is poroelastic

Apply sinusoidal displacement in one DOF at a time: +-0.25 mm compression, +-0.6 mm A-P/lateral shear, +-2 deg flexion-extension, +-3 deg lateral bending, +-2 deg axial rotation, at 0.001, 0.01, 0.1 and 1 Hz (other DOF held)
Stiffness = linear regression slope of force/moment vs displacement over cycles 2..end (loading and unloading; asymmetric DOFs split by direction); phase angle from cross-spectral density
protocol.notes: Coordinate system: Hexapod axes: +x anterior, +y left lateral, +z superior; rotations about the disc centre (from radiographs); upper vertebra driven, lower fixed. Posterior elements (transverse/spinous processes and facet joints) removed; ALL and PLL preserved. Values are mean (95% CI); sd derived as CI/t(0.975,n-1)*sqrt(n). Compressive stiffness converted by the authors (Table 3) to apparent modulus 23.6-34.4 MPa assuming 1500 mm2 area and 10 mm height.
